use: Independent homepage scenery based on Concept 05
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production BACKGROUND ONLY for the Urdu Khel children's game homepage, wide landscape 16:9, ideally 1792x1024 or wider.
Input image: the attached accepted Concept 05 is a STYLE and composition reference only. Recreate ONLY its warm cream atmosphere and charming dimensional green bushes at the bottom, with a little more richness and presence to the greenery. This is a separate reusable background asset, not a full UI mockup.
Scene: warm buttery cream/off-white backdrop, subtly warmer than pure white, around #fff3df to #fff9ed. Soft studio lighting and very subtle tactile clay finish. The upper 76% of the entire image is completely clear cream negative space, including all corners. The UI will be placed over it by code.
BOTTOM scenery: softly rolling pale sage/mint hills hug the bottom edge. In the bottom-left and bottom-right corners place substantial charming rounded little bushes and miniature round-canopy trees, made of matte sculpted green clay. A mixture of emerald, leaf green and pale sage, clearly 3D with soft lighting, curved silhouettes and delicate contact shadows. Similar to the shrub mounds at the bottom of the reference. Left cluster extends across the leftmost 20% of the width, right cluster extends across the rightmost 28%. The tallest greenery reaches no higher than the bottom 18% of the canvas. Low hills can extend across the width, but leave the bottom centre 35% as a quiet pale cream/mint shallow valley for pagination dots. Greenery feels warm and playful, not glossy plastic or photoreal leaves. Keep the corner bushes low and rounded, not a forest.
Constraints: render NO title, NO labels or text, NO letters, NO UI, NO tiles or cards, NO button, NO spider or other character, NO animals, NO toys, NO flowers, NO stars, NO watermark, NO frame. Every interface element in the reference must be absent. The final is a clean empty app background with a sculpted little garden ONLY along its bottom edge. All content above bottom 24% is clear warm cream. Preserve the quiet open composition and warm clay material.
